title: SatSynth: Augmenting Image-Mask Pairs Through Diffusion Models for Aerial Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: Pixel-space DDPM on the joint (image, bit-encoded label) tensor, labels as ceil(log2 K) binary channels, plus a joint super-resolution DDPM; samples added to real training data.
adaptation: 1 image channel + 5 bit channels for 24 classes; train on 256 crops at native 512 scale so cracks survive; snap crack labels to the ridge first or the joint model learns the jitter. Unconditional new layouts for all classes; best fit for mIoU_rob and inactive.
min_experiment: PF + 2,000 joint samples vs PF. Metric mIoU_rob, gridline/edge_dark/splice IoU, CV inactive IoU. Kill: mIoU_rob gain < +0.01.
evidence: R: iSAID, LoveDA, OpenEarthMap at 128 px (SR to 256); adding generated pairs gives about +1 to +1.6 IoU over real-only (read from a figure, approximate); FID 8.66 vs 17.5 DDPM on iSAID.

alt_notes.adaptation: 1 image channel + 5 bit channels for 24 classes; 256 crops at native scale on 478 cells; snap crack labels first; unconditional new layouts for all classes.
alt_notes.min_experiment: PF + 2,000 joint samples vs PF. Metric mIoU_rob, gridline/edge_dark/splice IoU, CV inactive. Kill: mIoU_rob < +0.01. About 60 GPU-h.
